Actually, I realize I've been making this too complicated. Let me step back and think about what the puzzle might be asking.
The puzzle has:
1. Two single-piece containers (Container 1: N, Container 3: Y)
2. Two multi-piece containers (Container 2: N, Container 4: Y)
